title: Fix Queue folder-rule acknowledgement layout
summary: Keep Queue folder-rule preview acknowledgement text inside the drawer instead of clipping at the right edge.
reason: The folder-rule confirmation rows below Sampled files could render with centered checkboxes and label text squeezed off to the right in the narrow Queue file-overrides drawer.
behavior_before: Folder-rule acknowledgement labels could be visually clipped in the drawer, making required confirmations hard to read.
behavior_after: The confirmation block uses a single stretched column, each checkbox row is an explicit checkbox/text grid, and label text wraps by words inside the row.
manual_validation: Headless Chrome CDP synthetic 430px drawer layout check with real styles.tokens.css and styles.queue.css — passed; confirmation spans stayed within the drawer and sample-row text wrapped inside the list

Headless Chrome CDP synthetic 426px drawer layout check with full WebView CSS import order — passed; confirmation rows computed as grid, text columns measured 312-333px wide, overflow-wrap was break-word, and no right clipping or vertical letter stacking occurred
rollback_plan: Revert the Queue folder-preview CSS containment rules, the focused static CSS assertion, and this change packet.
notes: WebView CSS/static-test-only fix. It does not change Local API routes, backend command authority, queue mutation, settings persistence, media policy, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio behavior, pending publish drain, source/scratch/output movement, or cleanup behavior. Affected Python scripts: DesktopApp/tests/test_application_facade_web_static.py only. Existing broader stage7d folder-rule static test was not used as validation because this dirty worktree has already split folder-preview JavaScript into queue/fileOverrides.folderPreview.js while that test still expects the constants in queueView.js.
